author: genegodbold
body:
There has been recent evidence from a paper in Science (https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41747053/) that a new pathway for innate immune activation occurs between the STING cytoplasmic detector and NF-kappaB. There are some virus components, including M1 from Alphainfluenzavirus influenzae, ORF3a from SARS-CoV-2, and E7 from human papillomavirus that interfere with this "new" pathway.

I'm proposing to expand the definition of how NF-kappaB can get activated. This may not need an issue, but I figured I'd drop it here, @pgaudet
title: Possible expansion of GO:0085034 (NFkappaB suppression by symbiont) definition
